title: 拨动开关：红灯还是绿灯
summary: 单刀双掷开关拨到一边亮红灯，拨到另一边亮绿灯。
description: 单刀双掷（SPDT）拨动开关有 3 只脚：中间的 com 是公共端，拨杆在 a 侧时 com 接 a，在 b 侧时 com 接 b。+5 V 接 com；a → 220 Ω → 红色 LED → GND；b → 220 Ω → 绿色 LED → GND。

cards.title: 二选一
text: 这一题没有步骤，**照目标电路图自己搭**。搭好后单击开关拨来拨去，看两颗灯。

cards.title: 一个刀，两个位置
text: - SPDT = **单刀双掷**：一个“刀”（com），可以合到两个位置之一（a 或 b）。
- 拨到 a：com–a 接通，红灯那条路通；b 那条路断开。拨到 b 正好相反。
- 所以两条支路**永远只有一条通**，不会两颗同时亮。

cards.title: 搭好再拨
text: - 开关三只脚占三个相邻的列：**左 a、中 com、右 b**。+5 V 要接到**中间**那列。
- 红灯接 a 侧，绿灯接 b 侧，两颗 LED 的短脚都回到蓝轨。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 单刀单掷（SPST）只能通 / 断；单刀双掷（SPDT）是**二选一**。家里楼梯上下两个开关控制同一盏灯，用的就是两个 SPDT。
- 没被选中的那一边是**悬空**的。接单片机输入时要小心，后面会讲。

caption.text: 拨到 a：com 和 a 接通，红灯那条路通，b 那条路断开。拨到 b 正好相反，所以两颗灯永远只亮一颗。

i18n.en: Set to a: com joins a, the red branch conducts and the b branch is open. Set to b it is the other way round, so only one LED is ever lit.

en.title: Toggle switch: red or green
en.summary: Flip an SPDT switch one way for the red LED, the other way for the green one.
en.description: A single-pole double-throw (SPDT) toggle switch has 3 pins: the middle one, com, is common; with the lever towards a, com connects to a, towards b, to b. +5 V to com; a → 220 Ω → red LED → GND; b → 220 Ω → green LED → GND.
hints: The switch's three pins take three neighbouring columns: a left, com middle, b right.
+5 V goes to the middle column (com).
Both LEDs' cathodes go back to the GND blue rail.
tests: Towards a: red on, green off
Towards b: green on, red off

cards.title: Pick one of two
text: No steps here — **build it from the target schematic**. Then click the switch back and forth and watch both LEDs.

cards.title: One pole, two throws
text: - SPDT = **single pole, double throw**: one "pole" (com) that can connect to one of two positions (a or b).
- Towards a: com–a closes and the red LED's path conducts; the b path is open. Towards b, the other way round.
- So **only one branch conducts at a time** — both LEDs are never lit together.

cards.title: Build it, then flip it
text: - The switch takes three neighbouring columns: **a on the left, com in the middle, b on the right**. +5 V goes to the **middle** column.
- Red LED on the a side, green on the b side; both short leads back to the blue rail.

cards.title: Take away
text: - SPST only opens and closes; SPDT **chooses one of two**. Two SPDT switches let you control a stairway light from upstairs and downstairs.
- The side not selected is left **floating**. Mind that when it drives a microcontroller input — more on that later.

measurements.ask: Is there any position where both LEDs light at once?
choices: No: com connects to only one of a and b at a time
Yes: in the middle position both sides connect
measurements.explain: An SPDT's pole has only two positions. A real switch even breaks one side before making the other while you flip it, so they never connect together.

measurements.ask: Switch towards a: measure the b pin's column relative to GND with the multimeter
measurements.explain: The b pin is cut off from the supply but still connected to GND through R2 and the green LED; with no current through them it sits at 0 V (it is not floating).

measurements.ask: 有没有哪个位置能让两颗灯同时亮？
choices: 没有：com 同一时刻只接 a 或 b 中的一个
有：拨到中间时两边都接通
measurements.explain: SPDT 的刀只有两个位置。真实的开关在拨动的一瞬间两边都断开（“先断后合”），也不会同时接通。

measurements.ask: 拨到 a，用万用表量 b 脚那一列对 GND 的电压
measurements.explain: b 脚和电源断开了，但它还通过 R2 和绿色 LED 接着 GND，没有电流流过，所以是 0 V（不是悬空）。

hints: 开关三只脚占三个相邻的列：左 a、中 com、右 b。
+5 V 要接到中间那一列（com）。
两个 LED 的负极都回到 GND 蓝轨。
